title: ASSURED record vocabulary
description: Shared definitions for the ASSURED record templates: the two verdict axes, case status, the close-or-escalate decision, priority bands, the matrix cell, ratings, confidence and depth. The enums mirror src/data/priority-matrix.ts; scripts/check-template-schemas.mjs fails when they drift. x-assured-forms lists the wording a template must offer the reader when it is not the enum values themselves.

detectionVerdict.description: Detection axis: did the rule fire correctly? A correct detection of authorized behavior is a true positive (a benign true positive on the activity axis), never a false positive.

activityVerdict.description: Activity axis: what was the activity?

caseStatus.description: Case status. "Merged into case" is a status, not a verdict.

escalationDecision.description: The close-or-escalate decision. Made and recorded by the Escalation decision (E); Risk only recommends. Early exits (a Level 0 close, an escalation-tripwire escalation from any phase) are early E decisions.

escalationBasis.description: Why a case escalated: a canonical criterion confirmed under the escalation tripwire (which makes it P1), the matrix cell at P1 or P2, or an operational route such as capacity.
enum: matrix cell at P1 or P2

recommendedMove.description: Risk's recommendation. Risk recommends; E decides.

priorityBand.description: Priority band from the triage matrix, or P1 from a confirmed criterion. Default clocks: P1 page immediately (no-acknowledgment fallback at 15 minutes); P2 acknowledge within 15 minutes, escalate within 4 hours; P3 re-score within 24 hours on a named trigger (High/Low within hours); P4 documented close within the queue SLA. Adopters tune the clocks.

matrixCell.description: The triage-matrix cell, written Impact/Likelihood (e.g. High/Medium).

override.description: A named override of the matrix cell.

rating.description: Impact or likelihood rating. Templates abbreviate it H/M/L. Unexamined evidence means low confidence, not low likelihood.

confidence.description: Analytic confidence on the shared rubric (documentation/standards). Between levels, round down. "Confirmed" means high.

depthLevel.description: Depth level worked. A case moves up the ladder, never down.

depth.description: Depth level, with any upward moves and their reasons.

criterionMark.description: An escalation-criteria checklist box: [S] suspected or [C] confirmed. Leave it out when the box does not apply.

incidentId.description: Incident ID, only if declared, e.g. INC-YYYYMMDD-NNN.

materialAiUse.description: Assistant and version, and which parts began as AI drafts; "none" if unassisted.

ruleRef.description: A detection rule as deployed: name, ID and version.

attackMapping.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs, with the ATT&CK version they were mapped against (e.g. Enterprise v19). Behavior, not indicators.
